source_title: Every Free Game Released On The Epic Games Store (October 2026)
source_excerpt:
Updated October 29, 2026, by Mark Sammut: Sorry We're Closed is now available to claim for free on the Epic Games Store. Flotsam has been revealed for November 5.
Every Thursday at 8 AM PT, new Epic Games Store free games become available, and you have exactly one week to claim them. From AAA juggernauts like Hogwarts Legacy to lesser-known indie darlings like Sker Ritual , these giveaways cover quite a wide gamut of releases, so it's always a good idea to check each week to make sure you don't miss something you might want.
This article updates weekly to match the current free Epic Games Store games while maintaining an ever-growing list that covers the site's full history . We are talking about hundreds of games spread over roughly 5 years, just to give you a sense of how many projects they've given away. Usually, Epic gives one week's notice for the next free title, but the site also stages "Mystery Events" a few times a year that keep things behind the curtain.
What free games has the Epic Games Store given away since 2018? What is currently free in 2026?
Just to be clear, this article only covers Epic Games Store's weekly giveaways that start and end every Thursday.
Epic Games Store's Current Free Games (October 29–November 5): Sorry We're Closed
One of the Epic Games Store's most exciting free games of 2026 , Sorry We're Closed is an absolutely fantastic giveaway that, naturally, ties into Halloween quite well. A homage to classic survival horror that doesn't simply stick to repeating that old-school formula, this 2024 game features both fixed-camera angles for exploration and first-person gunplay for, well, action. The second you aim a gun, the former transitions into the latter.
Sorry We're Closed is a fusion of nostalgic survival horror with a new perspective on combat, combining atmospheric environments with fixed-camera angles and the thrill of arcade-style first person shooting. Collect items and manage resources to help Michelle survive. Optional tank controls are available for those who enjoy the classic survival horror experience. – Epic Games Store Page
Now, to be clear, you are completely stationary while aiming a gun, so it's not like Sorry We're Closed suddenly becomes an FPS game. In practice, it's more like an arcade shooter during these sections, and a big part of the challenge is knowing when to switch between the two perspectives. The protagonist has a Third Eye that lets them see secrets and enemy weaknesses, which ties into both the combat and exploration.
Sorry We're Closed 's story is pretty interesting too, as you follow Michelle, a woman who is trying to escape a curse. The game has some light RPG elements, along with a cool neon punk aesthetic.
Epic Games Store's Upcoming Free Game (November 5–12): Flotsam & Idle Champions of the Forgotten Realms Pack
Drift In The Ocean And Create A Home
After a few weeks defined by scares, Epic Games Store's next free game is all about overcoming scarcity. (See what I did there?)
Flotsam is basically a cross between Waterworld and something like Townscaper ​​​​​, meaning you have to manage a floating community that is stuck in a watery post-apocalyptic hellscape. As reflected by its colorful art style, Flotsam doesn't take itself too seriously and works pretty well as a cozy city builder and colony sim. While incorporating survival elements, the game doesn't push that element too hard, and the focus is more on managing your town, collecting junk to use as resources, and recruiting specialists. Pretty straightforward, pretty fun.
Your drifters each have their own stories to tell. Recruit specialists who unlock new buildings, quests, and discoveries for your floating community.
Pajama Llama really put in the time to get Flotsam into its ultimate form, as the project spent quite a few years in early access before releasing its 1.0 version. That time was well-spent, resulting in a pretty great and well-liked game. City builders are an acquired taste, and Flotsam is certainly not among the most famous entries in the genre, but fans will likely have a good time.
Also, players who are into Idle Champions of the Forgotten Realms can pick up the Morte's Renown Pack for free next week.
